annotations.title: AI visibility (GEO) audit for one URL

description: Audits how visible one web page is to AI search engines and AI assistants: which of the major AI crawlers robots.txt allows or blocks, llms.txt and llms-full.txt presence, sitemap, and on-page signals (title, meta, canonical, structured data, headings, content readable without JavaScript). Returns a 0-100 score, grade and prioritised recommendations. Use it to check or monitor a site for generative-engine optimisation. Price: $0.02 per call, paid with x402.
